2b7ef5807bb419d3.title: TON Sites
2b7ef5807bb419d3.documentation:
Used to open [TON Sites](https://blog.ton.org/ton-sites) using the in-app [Telegram Browser](https://telegram.org/blog/w3-browser-mini-app-store#telegram-browser).  

Syntax:

```
tonsite://somesite.domain/path?query#hash
```

Also available without the `tonsite://` scheme for `.ton` domains:

```
getting-started.ton/path?query#hash
```

In both cases, the `#hash` part of the URL should **not** be ignored.  

To open such URLs:

* Replace the `tonsite` scheme with `https`
* Transform the host part of the URL as follows:
  * Replace all `.` characters with `-d`
  * Replace `-` characters with `-h` (except for the `-`s generated by the first replace)
  * Append a `.`
  * Append the domain name specified in the [ton_proxy_address client configuration parameter »](/api/config.md#ton-proxy-address)

The resulting URL should only be opened using the in-app [Telegram Browser](https://telegram.org/blog/w3-browser-mini-app-store#telegram-browser) (i.e. no option should be given to open such links using third party browsers).

63657dc62bb98f9e.title: Public username links
63657dc62bb98f9e.documentation:
Used to link to public users, groups and channels, see [here for more info on how to handle them »](/api/invites.md#public-usernames).  

`t.me` syntax:
```
t.me/<username>?text=<draft_text>&profile
```

`tg:` syntax:
```
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&text=<draft_text>&profile
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `username` | Required | Username to [check or import »](/api/invites.md#public-usernames) |
| `draft_text` | Optional | UTF-8 text to pre-enter into the text input bar, if the user can write in the chat. \
Before insertion: \
- Validate that the text is valid UTF-8. \
- If the text starts with a `@`, prepend a whitespace to it (to avoid triggering an [inline query](/api/bots/inline.md)). \
- Trim the text to [message_length_max](/constructor/config.md) UTF-8 codepoints. |
| `profile` | Optional | If set, clicking on this link should open the destination peer's profile page, not the chat view. |

Note that [message links](#message-links) and [monoforum links](#monoforum-links) have the same or similar syntax, with extra parameters.

5a813223f4b17694.title: Monoforum links
5a813223f4b17694.documentation:
Used to open the direct messages chat (aka [monoforum »](/api/monoforum.md)) associated to a channel, see [here for more info on monoforums »](/api/monoforum.md).  

**Note**: when sharing messages sent to a monoforum, use [normal message links »](#message-links) with the ID of the monoforum, not the ID of the associated channel; the same rule applies for all other chat-related links involving a monoforum.  

`t.me` syntax:
```
t.me/<username>?direct
```

`tg:` syntax:
```
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&direct
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `username` | Required | Username of the channel, that has an associated monoforum. |
| `direct` | Required | Distinguishes monoforum links from other link types. |

Note that [public username links](#public-username-links) have a similar syntax, but don't have the `direct` flag.

ab530a13e4591498.title: Message links
ab530a13e4591498.documentation:
Used to link to specific messages in public or private groups and channels.  

`t.me` syntax (public links):  
```
t.me/<username>/<id>?single&thread=<thread_id>&comment=<comment>&t=<media_timestamp>&task=<task_id>&option=<option_id>
t.me/<username>/<thread_id>/<id>?single&comment=<comment>&t=<media_timestamp>&task=<task_id>&option=<option_id>
```

`t.me` syntax (private links):  
```
t.me/c/<channel>/<id>?single&thread=<thread_id>&comment=<comment>&t=<media_timestamp>&task=<task_id>&option=<option_id>
t.me/c/<channel>/<thread_id>/<id>?single&comment=<comment>&t=<media_timestamp>&task=<task_id>&option=<option_id>
```

`tg:` syntax (public links):
```
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&post=<id>&single&thread=<thread_id>&comment=<comment>&t=<media_timestamp>&task=<task_id>&option=<option_id>
```

`tg:` syntax (private links):
```
tg://privatepost?channel=<channel>&post=<id>&single&thread=<thread_id>&comment=<comment>&t=<media_timestamp>&task=<task_id>&option=<option_id>
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `username` | Required if public link | Dialog username. |
| `channel` | Required if private link | Channel or supergroup ID. |
| `id` | Required | Message ID. |
| `single` | Optional | For albums/grouped media, if set indicates that this is a link to a specific media in the album; otherwise, it is a link to the entire album. |
| `thread_id` | Optional | For [message threads](/api/threads.md), contains the thread ID. |
| `comment` | Optional | For [channel comments](/api/discussion.md), `username` will contain the channel username, `id` will contain the message ID of the channel message that started the comment section and this field will contain the message ID of the comment in the discussion group. |
| `media_timestamp` | Optional | Timestamp at which to start playing the media file present in the body or in the webpage preview of the message, in the following formats: \
- Seconds: `123`, regex `^(\d+)$` \
- Minutes and seconds: `10:23`, example regex `^(\d+):(\d{1,2})$` \
- Hours, minutes and seconds: `1h23m10s`, example regex `^(?:(\d+)h)?(?:(\d{1,2})m)?(?:(\d{1,2})s)$` |
| `task_id` | Optional | Positive integer ID of a specific task to highlight, when the linked message contains a [checklist »](/api/todo.md), corresponding to a [todoItem](/constructor/todoItem.md).`id`. Invalid (non-positive or non-numeric) values should be treated as an error. |
| `option_id` | Optional | base64url-encoded identifier of a specific [poll »](/constructor/poll.md) option to highlight, when the linked message contains a poll, corresponding to a [pollAnswer](/constructor/pollAnswer.md).`option`. The decoded value must be valid UTF-8, otherwise it should be ignored. |

Note that since a [forum topic](/api/forum.md#forum-topics) ID is actually the ID of the service message that created the topic, whenever the client resolves a [message link](#message-links) that points to a [messageActionTopicCreate](/constructor/messageActionTopicCreate.md) service message, it should open the topic, instead.  
Also, if the message ID is `1` and the linked-to supergroup is a forum, the "General" topic should be opened instead of the first message of the supergroup.

c3bc45ac352fe43f.title: Share links
c3bc45ac352fe43f.documentation:
Used to share a prepared message and URL into a chosen chat's text field.  
These links should be handled as follows:

* Open a dialog selection prompt
* After selection: validate, trim and enter the URL at the beginning of the text field
* Append a newline to the text field
* Append and select the `text`, if present

`t.me` syntax:
```
t.me/share?url=<url>&text=<text>
t.me/share/url?url=<url>&text=<text>
t.me/share/url/?url=<url>&text=<text>
t.me/msg/url?url=<url>&text=<text>
```

`tg:` syntax:
```
tg://msg_url?url=<url>&text=<text>
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `url` | Required | URL to share (urlencoded) |
| `text` | Optional | Message to share |

fcf6ae3e2a64c6ed.title: Business chat links
fcf6ae3e2a64c6ed.documentation:
[Business chat deep links »](/api/business.md#business-chat-links) allow business owners to share pre-made links to their [Telegram Business](/api/business.md) account, optionally filling out the message input field with a pre-prepared message (with support for [styled text entities »](/api/entities.md)).  

There is no additional limit on the prepared message length (because the message text is *not* present in the URL's query string, but rather it's fetched from the server using the link slug); each created business chat deep link also has a view counter.  

See [here »](/api/business.md#business-chat-links) for more info on how to create, edit, resolve and get view information about business chat links.

These links should be handled as follows:

* Invoke [account.resolveBusinessChatLink](/method/account.resolveBusinessChatLink.md), passing the `slug` to obtain info about the link as a [account.resolvedBusinessChatLinks](/constructor/account.resolvedBusinessChatLinks.md) and increase the view counter.
* Open the returned `peer`, pre-filling the text input field with the returned `message` and `entities` (if present).  

`t.me` syntax:
```
t.me/m/<slug>
```

`tg:` syntax:
```
tg://message?slug=<slug>
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `slug` | Required | Slug to pass to [account.resolveBusinessChatLink](/method/account.resolveBusinessChatLink.md) and link management methods. |

56f77ba547af7aa5.title: Video chat/Livestream links
56f77ba547af7aa5.documentation:
Used to join video/voice chats in groups, and livestreams in channels.  
Such links are generated using [phone.exportGroupCallInvite](/method/phone.exportGroupCallInvite.md).  
Note that `voicechat` links are deprecated, the API will always export `videochat` links for video and voice chats in groups, clients should support parsing the old link format only for backwards compatibility.  

`t.me` syntax:
```
t.me/<username>?videochat
t.me/<username>?videochat=<invite_hash>
t.me/<username>?livestream
t.me/<username>?livestream=<invite_hash>
t.me/<username>?voicechat
t.me/<username>?voicechat=<invite_hash>
```

`tg:` syntax:
```
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&videochat
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&videochat=<invite_hash>
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&livestream
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&livestream=<invite_hash>
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&voicechat
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&voicechat=<invite_hash>
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `invite_hash` | Optional | Invite hash exported if the `can_self_unmute` flag is set when calling [phone.exportGroupCallInvite](/method/phone.exportGroupCallInvite.md): should be passed to [phone.joinGroupCall](/method/phone.joinGroupCall.md), allows the user to speak in livestreams or muted group chats. |

097f5a9023773650.title: Managed bot creation request links
097f5a9023773650.documentation:
Used to request creation of a new [managed bot »](/api/bots/managed-bots.md).  

Handle this link by starting the [managed bot creation flow »](/api/bots/managed-bots.md#creating-a-managed-bot), additionally setting the `via_deeplink` flag when finally invoking [bots.createBot](/method/bots.createBot.md).  

`t.me` syntax:
```
t.me/newbot/<manager_bot_username>/<suggested_bot_username>?name=<suggested_bot_name>
t.me/newbot/<manager_bot_username>?name=<suggested_bot_name>
```

`tg:` syntax:
```
tg://newbot?manager=<manager_bot_username>&username=<suggested_bot_username>&name=<suggested_bot_name>
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `manager_bot_username` | Required | Username of the manager bot, passed to [bots.createBot](/method/bots.createBot.md).`manager_id`. \
Before using this value, resolve it and make sure that it's associated to a manager bot (i.e. the resolved [user](/constructor/user.md) must have the `bot_can_manage_bots` flag set). |
| `suggested_bot_username` | Optional | Suggested username for the managed bot that will be created, passed to [bots.createBot](/method/bots.createBot.md).`username`. \
If non-empty, and the passed value does **not** end in `bot`, append `bot` to the value before recommending it to the user. \
Can be empty, in which case the user must choose a username before invoking [bots.createBot](/method/bots.createBot.md). |
| `suggested_bot_name` | Optional | Suggested name for the managed bot that will be created, passed to [bots.createBot](/method/bots.createBot.md).`name`. \
Can be empty, in which case the user must choose a name before invoking [bots.createBot](/method/bots.createBot.md). |

6e306c515177ca5a.title: OAuth links
6e306c515177ca5a.documentation:
Used to authorize an incoming [OAuth Telegram login request »](/api/url-authorization.md#oauth-authorization).  

Note that while the `token` must still be validated individually (it must be non-empty), the **entire deep link**, not just the `token` parameter, needs to be passed **verbatim** to [messages.requestUrlAuth](/method/messages.requestUrlAuth.md) as specified [here »](/api/url-authorization.md#oauth-authorization).   

**Important**: only handle this deep link if the request to open it comes from outside the app; do **not** handle it if it was clicked inside of the app, for example in messages, [buttons](/api/bots/buttons.md), the built-in browser and [mini apps](/api/bots/webapps.md), etc.  

Note that mini apps can still use OAuth login but [in a slightly different manner »](/api/url-authorization.md#oauth-authorization-for-mini-apps).  

`t.me` syntax:

```
https://t.me/oauth?startapp=<token>
```

`tg:` syntax:

```
tg://oauth?token=<token>
tg://resolve?domain=oauth&startapp=<token>
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `token` | Required | OAuth token, must be non-empty. |

70b6f28226ea3c89.title: Group/channel bot links
70b6f28226ea3c89.documentation:
Used to add bots to groups or channels.  
First of all, check that the `<bot_username>` indeed links to a bot.  
Then, for group links:
* If the `admin` parameter is not provided:
  * Bring up a dialog selection of groups where the user can add members
  * Add the bot to the group
  * If a `parameter` is provided, invoke [messages.startBot](/method/messages.startBot.md) with the appropriate `parameter`
* If the `admin` parameter is provided:
  * Bring up a dialog selection of groups where the user can add/edit admins
  * If the bot is already an admin of the group, combine existing admin rights with the admin rights in `admin`
  * Add the bot as admin/modify admin permissions to the new rights
  * If a `parameter` is provided, invoke [messages.startBot](/method/messages.startBot.md) with the appropriate `parameter`

For channel links:
  * Bring up a dialog selection of channels where the user can add/edit admins
  * If the bot is already an admin of the channel, combine existing admin rights with the admin rights in `admin`
  * Add the bot as admin/modify admin permissions to the new rights

`t.me` syntax (groups):
```
t.me/<bot_username>?startgroup=<parameter>&admin=<permissions>
t.me/<bot_username>?startgroup&admin=<permissions>
```

`tg:` syntax (groups):
```
tg://resolve?domain=<bot_username>&startgroup=<parameter>&admin=<permissions>
tg://resolve?domain=<bot_username>&startgroup&admin=<permissions>
```

`t.me` syntax (channels):
```
t.me/<bot_username>?startchannel&admin=<permissions>
```

`tg:` syntax (channels):
```
tg://resolve?domain=<bot_username>&startchannel&admin=<permissions>
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `bot_username` | Required | Bot username |
| `parameter` | Optional for group links, absent in channel links | Start parameter, only for group links, up to 64 base64url characters: if provided and the `bot_username` is indeed a bot, [messages.startBot](/method/messages.startBot.md) with the appropriate `parameter` should be invoked after adding the bot to the group.  |

```
t.me/<bot_username>/<short_name>?startapp=<start_parameter>&mode=<mode>
```

```
tg://resolve?domain=<bot_username>&appname=<short_name>&startapp=<start_parameter>&mode=<mode>
```

Parameters: 

| Name | Optional | Description |

| `startapp` | Optional | `start_param` to pass to [messages.requestAppWebView](/method/messages.requestAppWebView.md) |
| `mode` | Optional | If equal to `compact`, the [messages.requestAppWebView](/method/messages.requestAppWebView.md).`compact` flag must be set. \

84e5145a119c7263.title: Bot attachment or side menu links
84e5145a119c7263.documentation:
Used to install and open a [bot attachment or side menu »](/api/bots/attach.md) in a certain chat.  
For all link types, clients should first [install the associated bot attachment or side menu entry as specified here »](/api/bots/attach.md), and if the user accepts the installation prompt, open the Mini App using the following logic, depending on the link subtype:

#### Open in current chat

After installing the attachment/side menu entry globally, opens the associated mini app using [messages.requestWebView](/method/messages.requestWebView.md) in the currently open chat, by passing it to the `peer` parameter of [messages.requestWebView](/method/messages.requestWebView.md).  

If the current chat is not supported by the [attachMenuBot](/constructor/attachMenuBot.md).`peer_types` field: 

* If the user has just installed the attachment menu in the previous step, notify the user that the attachment menu was installed successfully.
* Otherwise, notify the user that the attachment menu webapp can't be opened in the specified chat.

`t.me` syntax:
```
t.me/<bot_username>?startattach
t.me/<bot_username>?startattach=<start_parameter>
``` 

`tg:` syntax:
```
tg://resolve?domain=<bot_username>&startattach
tg://resolve?domain=<bot_username>&startattach=<start_parameter>
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `bot_username` | Required | Username of the bot that owns the [attachment/side menu entry](/api/bots/attach.md) |
| `start_parameter` | Optional | If provided, should be passed to [messages.requestWebView](/method/messages.requestWebView.md).`start_param` |

#### Open in specific chat

After installing the attachment/side menu entry globally, opens the associated mini app using [messages.requestWebView](/method/messages.requestWebView.md) in a specific chat (passed to the `peer` parameter of [messages.requestWebView](/method/messages.requestWebView.md)).  

`t.me` syntax:
```
t.me/<username>?attach=<bot_username>
t.me/<username>?attach=<bot_username>&startattach=<start_parameter>
t.me/+<phone_number>?attach=<bot_username>
t.me/+<phone_number>?attach=<bot_username>&startattach=<start_parameter>
```

`tg:` syntax:
```
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&attach=<bot_username>
tg://resolve?domain=<username>&attach=<bot_username>&startattach=<start_parameter>
tg://resolve?phone=<phone_number>&attach=<bot_username>
tg://resolve?phone=<phone_number>&attach=<bot_username>&startattach=<start_parameter>
```

If the specified chat is not supported by the [attachMenuBot](/constructor/attachMenuBot.md).`peer_types` field: 

* If the user has just installed the attachment menu in the previous step, notify the user that the attachment menu was installed successfully.
* Otherwise, notify the user that the attachment menu webapp can't be opened in the specified chat.

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `username` | Required for [username links](#public-username-links) | Username of chat where to open the mini app |
| `phone_number` | Required for [phone number links](#phone-number-links) | Phone number of private chat where to the open mini app |
| `bot_username` | Required | Username of the bot that owns the [attachment/side menu](/api/bots/attach.md) |
| `start_parameter` | Optional | If provided, should be passed to [messages.requestWebView](/method/messages.requestWebView.md).`start_param` |

#### Open in any chat

After installing the attachment/side menu entry globally, opens a dialog selection form that will open the attachment menu mini app using [messages.requestWebView](/method/messages.requestWebView.md) in a specific chat (pass it to the `peer` parameter of [messages.requestWebView](/method/messages.requestWebView.md)).  

`t.me` syntax:
```
t.me/<bot_username>?startattach&choose=users+bots+groups+channels
t.me/<bot_username>?startattach=<start_parameter>&choose=users+bots+groups+channels
```

`tg:` syntax:
```
tg://resolve?domain=<bot_username>&startattach&choose=users+bots+groups+channels
tg://resolve?domain=<bot_username>&startattach=<start_parameter>&choose=users+bots+groups+channels
```

Parameters:

| Name | Optional | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| `bot_username` | Required | Username of the bot that owns the [attachment/side menu](/api/bots/attach.md) |
| `start_parameter` | Optional | If provided, should be passed to [messages.requestWebView](/method/messages.requestWebView.md).`start_param` |
| `choose` | Optional | A combination of `users`, `bots`, `groups`, `channels` separated by `+`: indicates the dialog types to show in the dialog selection popup: must be intersected with the dialog types contained in the [attachMenuBot](/constructor/attachMenuBot.md).`peer_types` field before use. |

1d0be5c466010540.title: Stars topup link

| `purpose` | Optional | Contains a string indicating the reason why the topup is required, that must be shown on the topup page (if activated), possible values: <!-- start_table topup -->\

- `subadvance12` - Buy **Stars** to keep your subscriptions active for the next 12 months.\
